variants.title: Object scene and enlarged junction
variants.navigation: Visible material and edition anchors plus a collection document; object links target corresponding numbered records.

ordered_sections.pattern: Unequal title/object scene with lower margin note
Large macro opposite a lower inset explanation
content_requirements: Original stitched seam and timber junction SVG

ordered_sections.pattern: One long bench beside a short collection heading
Short factual note across an occasional rule

variants.mobile_reflow: Title, full chair and lower note stack; macro narrows slightly and its explanatory copy is inset beneath it; bench and final note follow in reading order. Practical labels remain fourteen pixels.
distinguishing_features: Lower margin note tied to a visible gap
One companion rather than repeated chair thumbnails

variants.title: Measured collection document
variants.navigation: Return to the object scene, measurement and material anchors, plus matching Frame and Long record fragment IDs.

ordered_sections.pattern: Short title beside practical document introduction
Full-width paired front elevations on one baseline

content_requirements: Width, depth and height in HTML

ordered_sections.pattern: Material register beside a short serif heading
Native study-notes disclosure and sparse rights footer
content_requirements: Working scene and local rights links

variants.mobile_reflow: Document introduction precedes the overview drawing; complete dimension records stack below it and repeat all small diagram labels. Material register and disclosure become full-width readable blocks.
distinguishing_features: One shared baseline and illustrative scale
Paired HTML dimension records linked to drawing codes
Collection document task instead of single object hero
